summary: Zeros two DWORD fields at offsets 0x78 and 0x84 of the object, then conditionally invokes FlagFieldBitManipulation(0, 0, 1, 0) when the field at offset 0x64 is non-zero. Returns the callee result when the guard passes, otherwise returns 0.

operations.description: Branch on this+0x64 (this[25]): if non-zero, proceed to flag manipulation; otherwise return 0.
Call FlagFieldBitManipulation(0, 0, 1, 0) at 0x0054C030 when the guard at this+0x64 passes; its result becomes the return value.
Return 0 when the guard at this+0x64 fails; otherwise return the result of FlagFieldBitManipulation.
